description: Creates a contact, or updates the one that already exists for that phone number or BSUID (the business-scoped user id Meta sends; a contact may have one and no phone). Writes only to Cosend: it sends nothing and the contact is not notified. It does not change who can be messaged: only an opt-out stops a send, no opt-in is needed, and opt-outs are recorded on their own ledger.

attributes.description: Free-form values, replaced whole on PATCH. A key registered in /v1/contact-fields must hold a value of its type (text: a string; number: a number; date: YYYY-MM-DD; boolean: true or false; choice: one of its choices) or null; a PATCH that sets attributes must give every required field a value. A key that is not registered is kept as it comes.

name: upsert_contact
title: Create or update a contact
